department: Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences (IGPBS)

deadline.value: Fall 2027 international application deadline is March 1, 2027 (applications open September 1, 2026; domestic deadline April 1, 2027; Summer 2027 international deadline February 1, 2027).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Biomedical Sciences, and the GRE is not required for IGPBS applicants.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required for IGPBS applicants, both domestic and international.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Do not select a faculty mentor when applying; students complete three lab rotations before choosing a mentor toward the end of the third rotation.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary to identify and select a faculty mentor at the application stage and we actually discourage it. ... First semester students will select their faculty mentor toward the end of their third rotation.

funding.value: All IGPBS PhD students receive a guaranteed stipend ($34,150 for 2025–2026), full tuition remission, waived mandatory fees, and individual health insurance throughout their PhD studies.
funding.quote: The IGPBS program will pay all tuition costs for any course related to your degree, waive all related university fees, and pay for your individual health insurance premiums, plus stipend support throughout your PhD studies. ... Tuition is remitted and fees are waived for all IGPBS students. ... Guaranteed Stipend to Cover Living Expenses $34,150

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution (recommended minimum 3.25/4.0 GPA).
entry_route.quote: Admission to the IGPBS program requires a Bachelor's degree from an accredited undergraduate institution with a recommended minimum GPA of 3.25 on a 4.0 grading scale.

app_fee.value: IGPBS does not charge an application fee ($0.00 balance at submission for all applicants).
app_fee.quote: The IGPBS program does not charge an application fee for any applicant who applies to the program. When applicants submit their application, the application will show a balance of $0.00 for the application fee so no formal waiver is needed.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver is needed because IGPBS charges $0 application fee to all domestic and international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: The IGPBS program does not charge an application fee for any applicant who applies to the program. When applicants submit their application, the application will show a balance of $0.00 for the application fee so no formal waiver is needed.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for IGPBS domestic or international applicants (optional scores, if submitted, are considered; suggested 50% average V/Q, >=35% each).
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for IGPBS applicants, both domestic and international. However, if an applicant chooses to submit GRE scores, the scores will be considered during the application review.

toefl_min.value: IGPBS requires TOEFL iBT 95 minimum with at least 20 in each section (or 5.0 on the new 1–6 scale).
toefl_min.quote: For international applicants, a minimum TOEFL score of 95, with no less than 20 in any single section, or, an IELTS minimum overall score of 7.0, is required.

also.quote: Applicants to the IGPBS Graduate Program should meet the minimum scores listed below: TOEFL OLD iBT Minimum score = 95 (minimum score 20 in each category) TOEFL NEW iBT Minimum score = 5.0

ielts_min.value: IGPBS requires IELTS Academic 7.0 overall minimum.
ielts_min.quote: For international applicants, a minimum TOEFL score of 95, with no less than 20 in any single section, or, an IELTS minimum overall score of 7.0, is required.

notes: Umbrella biomedical PhD covering seven doctoral programs (Biochemistry & Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics & Systems Biology, Cancer Research, Immunology/Pathology/Infectious Disease, Integrative Physiology & Molecular Medicine, Molecular Genetics & Cell Biology, and Neuroscience). Applicants can enter multi-program (uncommitted) or single-program. International applicants must submit NACES course-by-course transcript evaluation.
